profiles.backup-runtime: SSH backup ceremony with separate WAL-G and logical-backup bucket principals.
profiles.pitr-runtime: Protected isolated restore ceremony; evidence returns through the native OpenSSH transport after protected host-key verification.
profiles.evidence-publisher: GitHub OIDC publisher for the content-addressed evidence mirror and immutable Actions artifacts.
profiles.evidence-verifier: Read-only closure verifier for the evidence mirror and GitHub Actions artifacts.
profiles.archive-freshness: Five-minute SSH health probe; no object-storage credential is exposed.

requiredVariables.name: WALG_SPACES_BUCKET
requiredVariables.meaning: Non-secret bucket coordinate for the active WAL-G write epoch.

requiredVariables.name: WALG_BACKUP_EPOCH
requiredVariables.meaning: Canonical active epoch slug bound to the WAL-G encryption key and object prefix.

requiredVariables.name: PITR_WALG_SPACES_BUCKET
requiredVariables.meaning: Non-secret read-only PITR bucket coordinate selected for the isolated target.

requiredVariables.name: PITR_WALG_BACKUP_EPOCH
requiredVariables.meaning: Canonical WAL-G epoch selected for the isolated target-only restore bundle.

requiredSecrets.name: PRODUCTION_BACKUP_DROPLET_HOST
requiredSecrets.meaning: Production droplet host name or IP address.

requiredSecrets.name: PRODUCTION_BACKUP_DROPLET_USER
requiredSecrets.meaning: SSH user on the production droplet.

requiredSecrets.name: PRODUCTION_BACKUP_DROPLET_SSH_KEY
requiredSecrets.meaning: Private SSH key matching the droplet user's authorized public key.
requiredSecrets.safeExample: -----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY----- ... -----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----

requiredSecrets.name: PRODUCTION_BACKUP_DROPLET_SSH_FINGERPRINT
requiredSecrets.meaning: Protected SHA256 fingerprint of the production droplet SSH host key.

requiredSecrets.name: SPACES_ENDPOINT
requiredSecrets.meaning: DigitalOcean Spaces S3-compatible regional endpoint.

requiredSecrets.name: SPACES_REGION
requiredSecrets.meaning: DigitalOcean Spaces signing region supplied explicitly to every AWS CLI and WAL-G ceremony.

requiredSecrets.name: PITR_SOURCE_SYSTEM_IDENTIFIER
requiredSecrets.meaning: Protected PostgreSQL system identifier for the production cluster; the isolated restore ceremony rejects any different source cluster.

requiredSecrets.name: WALG_SPACES_ACCESS_KEY_ID
requiredSecrets.meaning: Bucket-scoped key id used only by WAL-G archive/base-backup operations.

requiredSecrets.name: WALG_SPACES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
requiredSecrets.meaning: Secret paired with the WAL-G-only Spaces key id.

requiredSecrets.name: LOGICAL_BACKUP_SPACES_BUCKET
requiredSecrets.meaning: Bucket dedicated to snapshot-bound logical dumps and verification sidecars.

requiredSecrets.name: LOGICAL_BACKUP_SPACES_ACCESS_KEY_ID
requiredSecrets.meaning: Key id scoped only to the logical-backup bucket.

requiredSecrets.name: LOGICAL_BACKUP_SPACES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
requiredSecrets.meaning: Secret paired with the logical-backup-only key id.

requiredSecrets.name: LOGICAL_BACKUP_GPG_RECIPIENT
requiredSecrets.meaning: Recipient fingerprint for the independently escrowed GPG public key used to client-encrypt logical dumps before upload.

requiredSecrets.name: EVIDENCE_SPACES_BUCKET
requiredSecrets.meaning: Versioned content-addressed mirror for GitHub OIDC/Rekor-signed evidence records.

requiredSecrets.name: EVIDENCE_PUBLISHER_SPACES_ACCESS_KEY_ID
requiredSecrets.meaning: GitHub-only key id with write access to the signed evidence mirror bucket.

requiredSecrets.name: EVIDENCE_PUBLISHER_SPACES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
requiredSecrets.meaning: Secret paired with the GitHub-only evidence publisher key id.

requiredSecrets.name: EVIDENCE_VERIFIER_SPACES_ACCESS_KEY_ID
requiredSecrets.meaning: Read-only key id for the signed evidence mirror.

requiredSecrets.name: EVIDENCE_VERIFIER_SPACES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
requiredSecrets.meaning: Secret paired with the read-only evidence verifier key id.

requiredSecrets.name: BACKUP_POSTGRES_USER
requiredSecrets.meaning: PostgreSQL role used by protected backup and restore commands.

requiredSecrets.name: BACKUP_POSTGRES_DB
requiredSecrets.meaning: Production PostgreSQL database name.

requiredSecrets.name: BACKUP_POSTGRES_PASSWORD
requiredSecrets.meaning: Password passed to PostgreSQL tools only through the protected remote process environment.

requiredSecrets.name: WALG_LIBSODIUM_KEY_B64
requiredSecrets.meaning: Canonical base64 text encoding of the independently escrowed 32-byte WAL-G client-encryption key.

requiredSecrets.name: PITR_WALG_SPACES_ACCESS_KEY_ID
requiredSecrets.meaning: Read-only key id used only by the isolated PITR target to fetch the selected WAL-G chain.

requiredSecrets.name: PITR_WALG_SPACES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
requiredSecrets.meaning: Secret paired with the read-only isolated-PITR object-store key id.

requiredSecrets.name: PITR_WALG_LIBSODIUM_KEY_B64
requiredSecrets.meaning: Escrowed client-decryption key for the selected isolated PITR epoch; never installed into the source container.
